topic.name: 军事、安全与突发事件
topic.description: 追踪冲突、军备、公共安全和仍在发展的重大事件

overview: 今日专题“军事、安全与突发事件”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Canada could work with Chinese automakers if US trade talks fail, says Carney
featured.summary: Ahead of Apec summit, PM says ‘Canada is going to move forward either way’ when asked if Chinese investment was leverage in US negotiations The prime minister of Canada, Mark Carney, said the country could turn to Chinese automakers if trade negotiations with the US president, Donald Trump, failed to preserve an integrated North American auto industry. Carney’s comments in Cambodia on Monday came ahead of a planned meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Shenzhen, China, where auto manufacturing is expected to be discussed. The two leaders reached an agreement in January allowing tens of thousands of Chinese electric vehicles into Canada at reduced tariffs. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 卡尼称若美贸易谈判失败，加拿大可能与中国汽车制造商合作
featured.summaryZh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示，如果与美国总统特朗普的贸易谈判无法维持北美汽车工业的整合，加拿大将寻求与中国汽车制造商合作。卡尼在前往深圳与中国领导人会晤前发表了上述言论，此前两国已达成协议允许部分中国电动汽车进入加拿大市场。
featured.whyImportant: 这表明加拿大在面对美国贸易压力时，正寻求通过加强与中国的经济联系来保障其汽车产业的多元化。

featured.title: MP Helen Haines’s first words since leaving hospital after alleged attack led to double amputation
featured.summary: Independent MP says she is ‘overwhelmed’ by thousands of warm wishes and thanks Australians for charity donations Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast The independent Australian MP Helen Haines has been discharged from hospital, four weeks after she was allegedly attacked by a man outside her electorate office in Victoria resulting in the double amputation of her legs. In a statement, Haines said she had moved to the rehabilitation stage of her recovery, which would continue in Melbourne. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 海伦·海恩斯议员在遭遇袭击导致双腿截肢后首次发声
featured.summaryZh: 澳大利亚独立议员海伦·海恩斯在遭遇袭击并导致双腿截肢四周后已出院。她表示对收到的数千份祝福感到“不知所措”，并感谢澳大利亚民众的捐款，目前她已转入墨尔本进行康复治疗。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件引发了对议员人身安全及公共暴力问题的广泛关注。

featured.summary: Estonia said Sunday it would close its border with Russia after stopping what it said was an attempted arson attack by Russia’s GRU military intelligence on a drone factory. tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 爱沙尼亚称挫败俄方破坏企图，将关闭与俄罗斯边境
featured.summaryZh: 爱沙尼亚宣布将于12月1日起关闭所有与俄罗斯的边境口岸。此前，爱沙尼亚称挫败了一起由俄罗斯军事情报机构策划的针对无人机工厂的纵火袭击，此举标志着两国紧张局势的显著升级。
featured.whyImportant: 该决定反映了波罗的海国家与俄罗斯之间日益加剧的地缘政治对抗。

featured.title: Houthis advance on Yemen government stronghold of Aden
featured.summary: Yemen’s Houthis were advancing on the interim seat of the internationally recognised government on Sunday, positioned just 60km from Aden, sources told Agence France-Presse, as government forces rushed to defend the city. Four military sources within government forces and two government sources said the Houthis had seized control of two districts in Lahj province and were moving towards Aden. They said the Houthis were positioned at the Al-Kharaz camp in Al-Madariba, 60km (about 40 miles) from...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 胡塞武装向也门政府大本营亚丁推进
featured.summaryZh: 据军事消息人士透露，胡塞武装已夺取拉赫季省两个地区，目前距离也门国际承认政府的临时所在地亚丁仅60公里。政府军正紧急调动力量以保卫该城市。
featured.whyImportant: 胡塞武装的推进威胁到也门合法政府的最后据点，可能导致该国冲突进一步恶化。

featured.title: Home Office accused of trying to cancel online talk by Andreas Malm
featured.summary: Hackney mayor decries ‘assault’ on free speech over event featuring academic who is banned from entering UK Shabana Mahmood has been accused of an “assault” on free speech over claims her officials tried to cancel an online talk by the climate academic Andreas Malm days after he was banned from entering the UK. The event in Hackney, east London, was a launch party for the socialist magazine Tribune. It went ahead on 4 November in defiance of Home Office warnings. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 英国内政部被指试图取消安德烈亚斯·马尔姆的在线讲座
featured.summaryZh: 气候学者安德烈亚斯·马尔姆被禁止入境英国后，其参与的在线讲座遭到内政部官员试图干预。哈克尼区长批评此举是对言论自由的“攻击”，该活动最终在无视内政部警告的情况下如期举行。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于政府权力边界及学术言论自由的争议。

featured.title: Tech failure forces hundreds of University of Melbourne students to abandon final exams mid-test
featured.summary: Students left in limbo after digital platform fails during exams, with university saying ‘third-party technical partners’ likely to blame for issue Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Hundreds of students at the University of Melbourne were forced to abandon their final exams on Monday morning after many were unable to access the digital platform needed to begin them. Jol Scobie, a first-year student at the university, was set to take his Australian politics exam on Monday after preparing for weeks. He had initially been told earlier in the year it was going to be a hand-written essay before instructors changed the test to a digital platform. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 技术故障迫使墨尔本大学数百名学生中断期末考试
featured.summaryZh: 墨尔本大学的数百名学生因数字考试平台故障，被迫在考试中途放弃作答。校方将故障归咎于第三方技术合作伙伴，受影响学生面临考试安排的不确定性。
featured.whyImportant: 此次大规模技术故障严重影响了学生的学业评估及考试公平性。

featured.title: Queensland and NT to stick with puberty blocker bans for transgender children against NHMRC advice
featured.summary: Queensland health minister Tim Nicholls says position on treatment ban in public hospitals ‘remains unchanged’ despite new guidelines Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The federal health minister, Mark Butler, says he’s confident Queensland and Northern Territory will consider the advice of Australia’s “pre-eminent authority” over their bans on puberty blockers for transgender children. The federal government last year commissioned the commonwealth-funded National Health and Medical Research Council (NHMRC) to develop the advice in response to bans in public hospitals imposed by the two governments. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 昆士兰州和北领地无视国家卫生与医学研究委员会建议，坚持禁止为跨性别儿童提供青春期阻断剂
featured.summaryZh: 尽管联邦政府资助的机构发布了新建议，昆士兰州和北领地政府仍坚持在公立医院禁止使用青春期阻断剂。联邦卫生部长表示，希望这两个地区能重新考虑权威机构的专业建议。
featured.whyImportant: 该争议凸显了澳大利亚在跨性别医疗政策上的地区差异与政治分歧。

featured.title: Senior Hells Angels bikie charged with threatening to kill investigative reporter Nick McKenzie
featured.summary: Victoria police allege man, suspected of being a chapter president of the gang, sent ‘threats and harassing text messages’ to Nine journalist Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A senior Hells Angel has been charged with threatening to kill Nine’s investigative reporter Nick McKenzie, the Victorian police taskforce investigating corruption in the building sector has confirmed. Police said detectives from the taskforce had charged a man on Monday, after he “sent a number of allegedly threatening, offensive and abusive text messages” to the Age journalist on Friday. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 地狱天使摩托车帮派高层被控威胁杀害调查记者尼克·麦肯齐
featured.summaryZh: 维多利亚州警方指控一名地狱天使帮派高层成员，称其向《时代报》调查记者尼克·麦肯齐发送了威胁和骚扰短信。该嫌疑人被认为是该帮派的分会主席。
featured.whyImportant: 针对调查记者的暴力威胁引发了对新闻自由和有组织犯罪影响力的担忧。

global.title: Huge waves pummel California coast, forcing closure of popular piers
global.summary: Large waves up to 50ft flooded southern California streets and prompted evacuation warning near coastal city The California coast was pummeled again on Sunday by huge waves that inundated beaches, flooded local streets and forced the closure of popular piers. The National Weather Service office for the San Francisco Bay Area warned that surf up to 35ft (11 meters) was possible, along with dangerous rip currents and sneaker waves. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
global.titleZh: 巨浪袭击加州海岸，迫使多个热门码头关闭
global.summaryZh: 加州海岸近日遭受高达50英尺的巨浪袭击，导致海滩被淹、街道积水，多个热门码头被迫关闭。气象部门已发布警告，提醒民众警惕危险的离岸流和突发巨浪。
global.whyImportant: 极端天气对沿海基础设施造成了严重破坏，并对居民安全构成威胁。

global.title: Nato to skip 2027 summit as high-level meetings are scaled back
global.summary: Nato is scaling back its high-level meetings and will not hold a leaders’ summit in Albania next year as previously planned amid tension within the alliance over defence spending, Iran and the war in Ukraine. Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama said on Thursday that “there is not yet a common position on when the summit will happen, for sure not in 2027”. He said that “in 2028, if it will be a summit, it will be in Tirana”, Albania’s capital. Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte played down the issue....
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
global.titleZh: 北约将取消2027年峰会，高层会议规模缩减
global.summaryZh: 受国防开支、伊朗问题及乌克兰战争等内部紧张局势影响，北约决定缩减高层会议规模，并取消原定于2027年在阿尔巴尼亚举行的领导人峰会。阿尔巴尼亚总理拉马表示，目前尚未就峰会时间达成共识，若2028年举办峰会，地点将设在地拉那。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了北约内部在关键地缘政治议题上的分歧，以及对大型外交活动安排的调整。

global.title: Megaspeed, firm at centre of Nvidia scandal, says Alice Huang left in 2025
global.summary: Chinese tech executive romantically linked to ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left in August 2025, Singapore-based firm says.
global.titleZh: 英伟达丑闻核心公司Megaspeed称Alice Huang已于2025年离职
global.summaryZh: 总部位于新加坡的Megaspeed公司表示，此前与英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋传出恋情绯闻的中国高管Alice Huang已于2025年8月离职。
global.whyImportant: 该声明旨在澄清与英伟达相关丑闻中关键人物的雇佣状态。

china.title: Hong Kong’s John Lee pledges stronger regional ties ahead of Apec summit trip
china.summary: Hong Kong’s leader will depart for the Apec conferences in Shenzhen on Tuesday, as he pledges to strengthen connectivity with other economies and contribute to regional prosperity and development. A government spokesman said on Monday that Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu would attend the Apec CEO Summit on Tuesday and Wednesday, as well as the Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting on Thursday. Lee said that Apec member economies were important trading partners of the city, accounting for as much as 87...
china.titleZh: 香港特首李家超在出席APEC峰会前承诺加强区域联系
china.summaryZh: 香港行政长官李家超将于周二启程前往深圳参加APEC峰会，重点参与CEO峰会及经济领导人会议。李家超强调，APEC成员经济体是香港重要的贸易伙伴，占其贸易总额的87%，他将致力于促进区域繁荣与合作。
china.whyImportant: 此行旨在巩固香港作为区域贸易枢纽的地位，并深化与亚太经济体的经贸往来。

china.title: Vuk Jeremic on US-Europe fracture, EU-China tensions and adjusting to a multipolar world
china.summary: Vuk Jeremic is a former Serbian foreign minister and served as president of the United Nations General Assembly from 2012 to 2013. He was also a candidate for UN secretary general in 2016, finishing in second place behind Antonio Guterres. china.titleZh: 武克·耶雷米奇谈美欧裂痕、欧中紧张关系及多极世界的适应

china.whyImportant: 专家视角为理解当前全球权力结构重组及主要大国间的博弈提供了深度参考。

china.summary: China’s activities in the South China Sea’s disputed waters could face greater challenges as the US, Japan, Australia and the Philippines accelerate efforts to build a joint operational structure and strengthen their collective response, analysts said. china.titleZh: 四国防御中心能否在南海制衡北京？

china.whyImportant: 该防御机制的建立标志着相关国家在南海问题上采取了更紧密的集体安全协作，可能加剧区域紧张局势。

china.titleZh: 中国驻美大使呼吁香港促进中美两大国合作
china.summaryZh: 中国驻美大使谢锋在美中香港论坛上发表视频致辞，呼吁香港利用自身独特优势，促进中美两国的人文交流与深度合作。他同时肯定了香港首任特首董建华在加强双边关系方面的贡献。
china.whyImportant: 此举显示中国希望香港继续发挥“超级联系人”作用，在复杂的中美关系中起到缓和与促进合作的桥梁作用。

usa.title: Goodbye, overtourism? Sustainable travel gains ground
usa.summary: As tourism booms across Latin America, alternative forms of travel are gaining ground. Making your holiday more sustainable means rethinking who calls the shots, who invests and who benefits.
usa.titleZh: 再见，过度旅游？可持续旅行渐成主流
usa.summaryZh: 随着拉丁美洲旅游业的蓬勃发展，替代性的旅行方式正逐渐兴起。实现更可持续的度假意味着需要重新审视旅游业的决策权、投资流向及受益群体。
usa.whyImportant: 这一趋势反映了全球旅游业正从单纯的经济增长转向更加注重社会公平与环境责任的模式。

usa.titleZh: 中国在深圳APEC峰会前呼吁与美国开展人工智能合作
usa.summaryZh: 中国驻美大使谢锋表示，希望在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会上实现大国合作，并推广由中国主导的人工智能联盟以促进区域繁荣。官方媒体重申了构建“亚太命运共同体”的愿景。
usa.whyImportant: 中美在人工智能领域的合作意向对全球科技治理及区域经济稳定具有重要影响。

usa.title: ‘The blood of these brothers cries out’: Pope Leo demands justice for people killed protecting the Amazon
usa.summary: Pontiff delivers forceful speech on final day in Peru as he travels from high in the Andes into the Amazon Pope Leo XIV has demanded justice for environmental defenders killed for protecting the Amazon and backed efforts by Indigenous peoples to stop their lands from being ravaged by logging and illegal mining. On the penultimate day of his South American tour, Leo on Sunday travelled into the Peruvian Amazon and channelled one of Pope Francis’s core teachings that links care for the most vulnerable with care for God’s creation. usa.titleZh: “这些兄弟的血在呼喊”：教皇利奥要求为保护亚马逊而牺牲的人伸张正义

usa.whyImportant: 教皇的表态提升了国际社会对环境捍卫者安全及亚马逊生态保护问题的关注度。

usa.title: US officials recover audio from ‘Mississippi miracle’ cruise ship and tanker crash
usa.summary: Tank vessel suffered sudden steering failure two minutes before slamming into docked riverboat near New Orleans Federal safety investigators with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) recovered audio and released a preliminary timeline on Sunday of a collision between a cruise ship and a tanker vessel in the Mississippi River on Friday. The data was retrieved after more than 30 people were injured when a tanker collided with a docked cruise ship – American Cruise Lines’ American Heritage riverboat – near the port of New Orleans on Friday at about 12.30pm. All passengers aboard the cruise ship have been accounted for, officials said. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 美国官员从“密西西比奇迹”游轮与油轮相撞事故中找回音频
usa.summaryZh: 美国国家运输安全委员会已找回事故音频，并公布了上周五密西西比河游轮与油轮相撞事件的初步时间表。事故导致30多人受伤，目前所有乘客均已获救。
usa.whyImportant: 事故调查结果将有助于厘清航运安全隐患并防止类似碰撞事故再次发生。

watch.titleZh: 韩国在高考前打击网上“考试药”销售
watch.summaryZh: 韩国食品药品安全部在高考前夕发现571条非法销售处方药的在线帖子，这些药物被伪装成“学习增强剂”或“考试药”。监管部门已发出警告，提醒学生和家长切勿从非正规渠道购买药物。
watch.whyImportant: 此举旨在保障考生的用药安全，并遏制非法药物在校园及考试期间的滥用风险。

watch.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统表示，星链网络速度受限导致乌方难以有效抵御俄罗斯的攻击。他呼吁相关方解除限制，以支持乌克兰的防御行动。
watch.whyImportant: 星链服务的可用性直接影响到乌克兰在冲突中的通信能力与战场态势感知。

watch.summaryZh: 由于美国食品药品监督管理局拒绝了依沃西单抗的上市申请，康方生物股价周一大幅下跌。美方合作伙伴表示，该药物未能提供充分的有效性证据，引发了投资者对公司商业前景的担忧。
watch.whyImportant: 此次监管挫折对中国创新药出海进程及相关企业的市场估值产生了显著冲击。

items.title: Canada could work with Chinese automakers if US trade talks fail, says Carney
items.summary: Ahead of Apec summit, PM says ‘Canada is going to move forward either way’ when asked if Chinese investment was leverage in US negotiations The prime minister of Canada, Mark Carney, said the country could turn to Chinese automakers if trade negotiations with the US president, Donald Trump, failed to preserve an integrated North American auto industry. Carney’s comments in Cambodia on Monday came ahead of a planned meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Shenzhen, China, where auto manufacturing is expected to be discussed. items.summaryZh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示，如果与美国总统特朗普的贸易谈判无法维持北美汽车工业的整合，加拿大将寻求与中国汽车制造商合作。卡尼在前往深圳与中国领导人会晤前发表了上述言论，此前两国已达成协议允许部分中国电动汽车进入加拿大市场。
items.whyImportant: 这表明加拿大在面对美国贸易压力时，正寻求通过加强与中国的经济联系来保障其汽车产业的多元化。

items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚独立议员海伦·海恩斯在遭遇袭击并导致双腿截肢四周后已出院。她表示对收到的数千份祝福感到“不知所措”，并感谢澳大利亚民众的捐款，目前她已转入墨尔本进行康复治疗。

items.titleZh: 爱沙尼亚称挫败俄方破坏企图，将关闭与俄罗斯边境
items.summaryZh: 爱沙尼亚宣布将于12月1日起关闭所有与俄罗斯的边境口岸。此前，爱沙尼亚称挫败了一起由俄罗斯军事情报机构策划的针对无人机工厂的纵火袭击，此举标志着两国紧张局势的显著升级。

items.titleZh: 胡塞武装向也门政府大本营亚丁推进

items.titleZh: 英国内政部被指试图取消安德烈亚斯·马尔姆的在线讲座

items.title: Senior Hells Angels bikie charged with threatening to kill investigative reporter Nick McKenzie
items.summary: Victoria police allege man, suspected of being a chapter president of the gang, sent ‘threats and harassing text messages’ to Nine journalist Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A senior Hells Angel has been charged with threatening to kill Nine’s investigative reporter Nick McKenzie, the Victorian police taskforce investigating corruption in the building sector has confirmed. items.title: Huge waves pummel California coast, forcing closure of popular piers
items.summary: Large waves up to 50ft flooded southern California streets and prompted evacuation warning near coastal city The California coast was pummeled again on Sunday by huge waves that inundated beaches, flooded local streets and forced the closure of popular piers. items.titleZh: 巨浪袭击加州海岸，迫使多个热门码头关闭

items.title: Nato to skip 2027 summit as high-level meetings are scaled back

items.titleZh: 北约将取消2027年峰会，高层会议规模缩减

items.summary: Chinese tech executive romantically linked to ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left in August 2025, Singapore-based firm says.
items.titleZh: 英伟达丑闻核心公司Megaspeed称Alice Huang已于2025年离职
items.summaryZh: 总部位于新加坡的Megaspeed公司表示，此前与英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋传出恋情绯闻的中国高管Alice Huang已于2025年8月离职。
items.whyImportant: 该声明旨在澄清与英伟达相关丑闻中关键人物的雇佣状态。

items.title: Hong Kong’s John Lee pledges stronger regional ties ahead of Apec summit trip
items.summary: Hong Kong’s leader will depart for the Apec conferences in Shenzhen on Tuesday, as he pledges to strengthen connectivity with other economies and contribute to regional prosperity and development. A government spokesman said on Monday that Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu would attend the Apec CEO Summit on Tuesday and Wednesday, as well as the Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting on Thursday. Lee said that Apec member economies were important trading partners of the city, accounting for as much as 87...
items.titleZh: 香港特首李家超在出席APEC峰会前承诺加强区域联系
items.summaryZh: 香港行政长官李家超将于周二启程前往深圳参加APEC峰会，重点参与CEO峰会及经济领导人会议。李家超强调，APEC成员经济体是香港重要的贸易伙伴，占其贸易总额的87%，他将致力于促进区域繁荣与合作。
items.whyImportant: 此行旨在巩固香港作为区域贸易枢纽的地位，并深化与亚太经济体的经贸往来。

items.title: Vuk Jeremic on US-Europe fracture, EU-China tensions and adjusting to a multipolar world
items.summary: Vuk Jeremic is a former Serbian foreign minister and served as president of the United Nations General Assembly from 2012 to 2013. He was also a candidate for UN secretary general in 2016, finishing in second place behind Antonio Guterres. Jeremic now heads the Centre for International Relations and Sustainable Development, a think tank based in Serbia. In this Open Questions interview, Jeremic discusses Europe’s geopolitical standing, transatlantic ties and China-Europe relations. He also...
items.titleZh: 武克·耶雷米奇谈美欧裂痕、欧中紧张关系及多极世界的适应
items.summaryZh: 前塞尔维亚外长及联合国大会主席武克·耶雷米奇在采访中探讨了欧洲的地缘政治地位、跨大西洋关系以及中欧关系。他分析了在当前多极化趋势下，各国如何应对复杂的国际格局。
items.whyImportant: 专家视角为理解当前全球权力结构重组及主要大国间的博弈提供了深度参考。

items.title: Can a new 4-country defence hub counter Beijing in the South China Sea?
items.summary: China’s activities in the South China Sea’s disputed waters could face greater challenges as the US, Japan, Australia and the Philippines accelerate efforts to build a joint operational structure and strengthen their collective response, analysts said. Under an agreement reached on October 28 and made public on November 10, the four countries plan to establish a defence coordination centre in the Philippines, a move that could improve intelligence sharing, joint surveillance and their ability to...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 四国防御中心能否在南海制衡北京？
items.summaryZh: 美国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾正加速建立联合行动结构，计划在菲律宾设立防御协调中心。此举旨在加强情报共享与联合监视，以应对中国在南海争议水域的活动。
items.whyImportant: 该防御机制的建立标志着相关国家在南海问题上采取了更紧密的集体安全协作，可能加剧区域紧张局势。

items.title: China’s envoy to US calls on Hong Kong to foster cooperation between 2 superpowers
items.summary: China’s envoy to the United States has called on Hong Kong to make full use of its unique advantages to foster interpersonal exchanges, deepen cooperation between the two superpowers and become a leading hub “for win-win partnerships”. In a video address to the US-China Hong Kong Forum held at The Fullerton Hotel in Aberdeen on Monday, Chinese ambassador to the United States Xie Feng also paid tribute to Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first chief executive, praising his efforts to strengthen ties...
items.titleZh: 中国驻美大使呼吁香港促进中美两大国合作
items.summaryZh: 中国驻美大使谢锋在美中香港论坛上发表视频致辞，呼吁香港利用自身独特优势，促进中美两国的人文交流与深度合作。他同时肯定了香港首任特首董建华在加强双边关系方面的贡献。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示中国希望香港继续发挥“超级联系人”作用，在复杂的中美关系中起到缓和与促进合作的桥梁作用。

items.title: ICYMI: Secretary Duffy’s Full Sunday Circuit Outlines Ground Stop Response and the Path Forward
items.summary: This morning, Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy appeared on all five Sunday shows to level with the American people about Friday’s nationwide ground stop. Secretary Duffy laid out the Trump Administration’s decisive actions to isolate the problem and restore the airspace and shared preliminary findings from the investigation. items.titleZh: 回顾：交通部长达菲在周日节目中概述地面停飞应对措施及未来路径
items.summaryZh: 美国交通部长肖恩·达菲在周日系列节目中回应了上周五全国范围内的地面停飞事件。他阐述了特朗普政府为解决问题和恢复空域运行所采取的果断行动，并分享了初步调查结果。
items.whyImportant: 政府高层对航空系统故障的公开回应，旨在平息公众对基础设施安全与管理能力的担忧。

items.title: Goodbye, overtourism? Sustainable travel gains ground
items.summary: As tourism booms across Latin America, alternative forms of travel are gaining ground. Making your holiday more sustainable means rethinking who calls the shots, who invests and who benefits.
items.titleZh: 再见，过度旅游？可持续旅行渐成主流
items.summaryZh: 随着拉丁美洲旅游业的蓬勃发展，替代性的旅行方式正逐渐兴起。实现更可持续的度假意味着需要重新审视旅游业的决策权、投资流向及受益群体。
items.whyImportant: 这一趋势反映了全球旅游业正从单纯的经济增长转向更加注重社会公平与环境责任的模式。

items.title: China calls for AI cooperation with the US ahead of Shenzhen Apec summit
items.summary: Chinese ambassador to the United States Xie Feng has signalled high hopes for major-power cooperation at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen this week, while promoting a China-led AI alliance for regional prosperity. The prosperity theme was also highlighted in Qiushi, the Communist Party’s flagship publication, which compiled a series of President Xi Jinping’s previous Apec speeches on building an “Asia-Pacific community with a shared future”. Since his first Apec meeting...
items.titleZh: 中国在深圳APEC峰会前呼吁与美国开展人工智能合作
items.summaryZh: 中国驻美大使谢锋表示，希望在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会上实现大国合作，并推广由中国主导的人工智能联盟以促进区域繁荣。官方媒体重申了构建“亚太命运共同体”的愿景。
items.whyImportant: 中美在人工智能领域的合作意向对全球科技治理及区域经济稳定具有重要影响。

items.title: ‘The blood of these brothers cries out’: Pope Leo demands justice for people killed protecting the Amazon
items.summary: Pontiff delivers forceful speech on final day in Peru as he travels from high in the Andes into the Amazon Pope Leo XIV has demanded justice for environmental defenders killed for protecting the Amazon and backed efforts by Indigenous peoples to stop their lands from being ravaged by logging and illegal mining. On the penultimate day of his South American tour, Leo on Sunday travelled into the Peruvian Amazon and channelled one of Pope Francis’s core teachings that links care for the most vulnerable with care for God’s creation. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “这些兄弟的血在呼喊”：教皇利奥要求为保护亚马逊而牺牲的人伸张正义
items.summaryZh: 教皇利奥十四世在秘鲁访问期间发表强硬讲话，要求为保护亚马逊雨林而遇害的环境捍卫者伸张正义。他支持原住民保护土地的努力，并强调关爱弱势群体与保护自然环境的紧密联系。
items.whyImportant: 教皇的表态提升了国际社会对环境捍卫者安全及亚马逊生态保护问题的关注度。

items.title: US officials recover audio from ‘Mississippi miracle’ cruise ship and tanker crash
items.summary: Tank vessel suffered sudden steering failure two minutes before slamming into docked riverboat near New Orleans Federal safety investigators with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) recovered audio and released a preliminary timeline on Sunday of a collision between a cruise ship and a tanker vessel in the Mississippi River on Friday. The data was retrieved after more than 30 people were injured when a tanker collided with a docked cruise ship – American Cruise Lines’ American Heritage riverboat – near the port of New Orleans on Friday at about 12.30pm. All passengers aboard the cruise ship have been accounted for, officials said. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国官员从“密西西比奇迹”游轮与油轮相撞事故中找回音频
items.summaryZh: 美国国家运输安全委员会已找回事故音频，并公布了上周五密西西比河游轮与油轮相撞事件的初步时间表。事故导致30多人受伤，目前所有乘客均已获救。
items.whyImportant: 事故调查结果将有助于厘清航运安全隐患并防止类似碰撞事故再次发生。

items.title: South Korea cracks down on online ‘exam pill’ sales ahead of national college exam
items.summary: South Korea’s drug safety agency has flagged 571 online posts illegally selling or promoting prescription drugs under misleading labels such as “study-enhancing drugs” and “exam pills” – warning students and parents against buying medication from unverified sources ahead of Thursday’s national college entrance exam, or Suneung. The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety said on Monday that it had identified the posts during an inspection conducted from October 26 to 30 and requested that relevant...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 韩国在高考前打击网上“考试药”销售
items.summaryZh: 韩国食品药品安全部在高考前夕发现571条非法销售处方药的在线帖子，这些药物被伪装成“学习增强剂”或“考试药”。监管部门已发出警告，提醒学生和家长切勿从非正规渠道购买药物。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在保障考生的用药安全，并遏制非法药物在校园及考试期间的滥用风险。

items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.summary: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基敦促美国和马斯克解除星链限制，站在“历史正确的一边”
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统表示，星链网络速度受限导致乌方难以有效抵御俄罗斯的攻击。他呼吁相关方解除限制，以支持乌克兰的防御行动。
items.whyImportant: 星链服务的可用性直接影响到乌克兰在冲突中的通信能力与战场态势感知。

items.title: Akeso shares plummet as Chinese firm’s cancer drug ivonescimab faces FDA setback
items.summary: Shares in Hong Kong-listed Akeso plunged as much as 31.8 per cent on Monday morning after the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) rejected its cancer drug application, raising investor worries over the company’s near-term commercial outlook. Ivonescimab, one of the most closely watched innovative drugs emerging from China, did not establish “substantial evidence of effectiveness”, said US firm Summit Therapeutics, which has the exclusive rights to develop and commercialise the drug in global...
items.titleZh: 康方生物股价暴跌，中国抗癌药依沃西单抗遭FDA挫折
items.summaryZh: 由于美国食品药品监督管理局拒绝了依沃西单抗的上市申请，康方生物股价周一大幅下跌。美方合作伙伴表示，该药物未能提供充分的有效性证据，引发了投资者对公司商业前景的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此次监管挫折对中国创新药出海进程及相关企业的市场估值产生了显著冲击。
